_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the Purpur and Purpur Geyser Floodgate eggs in pelican-eggs/minecraft (MIT).
name: Minecraft: Purpur
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Purpur, a Paper fork with many more gameplay settings, that runs Bukkit, Spigot and Paper plugins. Any Minecraft version Purpur has, checked against PurpurMC's checksums, with Geyser and Floodgate for Bedrock players as an option.
startup: read -r need 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version needs Java %s or newer, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } exit }' && GEYSER_BEDROCK_CLONE_REMOTE_PORT=true exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}} nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Purpur. Downloads the Purpur build for the chosen Minecraft
# version from PurpurMC and checks it against PurpurMC's checksum, and
# with Bedrock players on, Geyser and Floodgate from GeyserMC, checked
# against theirs. Worlds, plugins and settings are never touched, and a
# jar is only replaced once the new one has downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

api=https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur
ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# Geyser and Floodgate, newest builds, into plugins/ (updating the files
# already there, whatever they're called).
geyser() {
    [ "${BEDROCK_SUPPORT:-0}" = 1 ] || [ "${BEDROCK_SUPPORT:-0}" = true ] || return 0
    mkdir -p plugins
    local project file name sum have build
    for project in geyser floodgate; do
        build=$(get "https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/$project/versions/latest/builds/latest") ||
            fail "GeyserMC can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
        name=$(jq -r '.downloads.spigot.name' <<<"$build")
        sum=$(jq -r '.downloads.spigot.sha256' <<<"$build")
        file=$(find plugins -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname "$project-spigot*.jar" | head -n 1)
        [ -n "$file" ] || file="plugins/$name"
        have=$(sha256sum "$file" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1) || true
        if [ "$have" = "$sum" ]; then
            echo "$name $(jq -r '.version' <<<"$build") is already installed."
            continue
        fi
        echo "Downloading $name $(jq -r '.version' <<<"$build")"
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$file.new" "https://download.geysermc.org/v2/projects/$project/versions/latest/builds/latest/downloads/spigot"
        [ "$(sha256sum "$file.new" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || { rm -f "$file.new"; fail "The $name download didn't match GeyserMC's checksum. Reinstall to try again."; }
        mv -f "$file.new" "$file"
    done
}

if [ -n "${DL_PATH:-}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading the server jar from $DL_PATH"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$DL_PATH"
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
    rm -f .raptor-java
    geyser
    echo "Installed."
    exit 0
fi

versions=$(get "$api") || fail "PurpurMC can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
version="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ -z "$version" ] || [ "$version" = latest ]; then
    version=$(jq -r '.versions[-1]' <<<"$versions")
elif ! jq -e --arg v "$version" 'any(.versions[]; . == $v)' <<<"$versions" >/dev/null; then
    fail "Purpur has no Minecraft $version. Set Version to latest, or to a version Purpur has, such as $(jq -r '.versions[-1]' <<<"$versions")."
fi
builds=$(get "$api/$version") || fail "PurpurMC can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
build="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"
if [ -z "$build" ] || [ "$build" = latest ]; then
    build=$(jq -r '.builds.latest' <<<"$builds")
elif ! jq -e --arg b "$build" 'any(.builds.all[]; . == $b)' <<<"$builds" >/dev/null; then
    fail "Purpur has no build $build for Minecraft $version. Set Build to latest, or to one of its builds, such as $(jq -r '.builds.latest' <<<"$builds")."
fi
info=$(get "$api/$version/$build") || fail "PurpurMC can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
[ "$(jq -r '.result' <<<"$info")" = SUCCESS ] || fail "Purpur build $build for Minecraft $version failed to build upstream. Choose another build."
sum=$(jq -r '.md5' <<<"$info")

# The Java version that Minecraft version needs, from Mojang.
java=8
if manifest=$(get https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json); then
    meta_url=$(jq -r --arg v "$version" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url' <<<"$manifest")
    if [ -n "$meta_url" ] && meta=$(get "$meta_url"); then
        java=$(jq -r '.javaVersion.majorVersion // 8' <<<"$meta")
    fi
fi

if [ -f "$jar" ] && [ "$(md5sum "$jar" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "Purpur $version build $build is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Purpur $version build $build"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$api/$version/$build/download"
    [ "$(md5sum "$jar.new" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || { rm -f "$jar.new"; fail "The download didn't match PurpurMC's checksum. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
fi
geyser
# The Java version it needs, which the startup command checks.
echo "$java" > .raptor-java
echo "Installed Purpur $version build $build. It needs Java $java or newer."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Minecraft version, such as 1.21.4, or latest for the newest one Purpur has. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Build
variables.description: The Purpur build for that version, or latest for its newest build.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the server's jar file.

variables.name: Bedrock players
variables.description: Installs Geyser and Floodgate, so Bedrock players can join on the server's port too, and updates them on each reinstall.

variables.name: Download link
variables.description: A link to download the server jar from instead of PurpurMC, which only staff can set.
